notes: 0.3.5：AI 现在能真正看懂脚本的界面。inspect_ui 除控件框外，还能读出 ListView、ListBox、ComboBox、TreeView、Tab、状态栏和表头的每行每列文字，并给出勾选状态、当前选中项、滑块与进度条位置、日期时间、热键等当前值；也可按窗口句柄或进程号查看任意程序的窗口。另修复 inspect_ui / capture_ui 在 0.3.3、0.3.4 中找不到脚本窗口的问题，建议这两版用户升级。
notes_en: 0.3.5: The AI can now actually read a script's UI. inspect_ui still lists every control, but now also returns the rows and columns inside ListView, ListBox, ComboBox, TreeView, Tab, status bar and header controls, plus current values such as checkbox state, selected item, slider/progress position, date and hotkey. Any program's window can be inspected by window handle or process id. Also fixes inspect_ui / capture_ui failing to find script windows in 0.3.3 and 0.3.4 - users of those versions should upgrade.
